details.speaker: assistant
details.verdict: correct — entire turn was a fenced markdown code block, correctly stripped

issues.description: Claude <antThinking> XML tags pass through unstripped into sentence text
issues.fix: Add regex strip for <antThinking>[\s\S]*?</antThinking> in NormalizeStage or SegmentStage._stripCodeBlocks

issues.description: Markdown headers (## Title) persist in sentences, causing mega-sentences when section content concatenates under them
issues.fix: SegmentStage markdown header regex not matching all patterns — debug and fix. Also treat header lines as sentence boundaries.

issues.description: Bullet point markers (- , * ) remain at start of sentences
issues.fix: Verify bullet stripping regex coverage. Consider splitting each bullet item as separate sentence.

issues.description: Inline code references (`identifier`) persist with backtick characters
issues.fix: Strip backtick characters while preserving identifier text

issues.description: 469 sentences >500 chars, 114 >1000 chars. Entire bulleted lists or multi-paragraph sections become single sentences because segmenter only splits on .?! punctuation, not structural boundaries (newlines, bullets, headers).
issues.fix: Add structural boundary splitting (newline + bullet, newline + header) or defer to wtpsplit SLM

issues.description: File extensions (.js, .dart), decimal numbers ($2.4M), and method calls (runtime.call()) cause false sentence splits
issues.occurrences: not quantified — scattered across code-heavy conversations
issues.fix: Add common extensions to abbreviation set or use negative lookahead. Defer to wtpsplit for complete fix.

qualityAssessment.userSTT: excellent — disfluencies preserved, fragment filter correctly drops tiny acknowledgments, no false drops on meaningful content
qualityAssessment.assistantProse: good — running prose splits correctly at sentence boundaries
qualityAssessment.assistantStructured: poor — markdown headers, bullets, tables, and code references leak through; mega-sentences pervasive
qualityAssessment.overallVerdict: Pipeline works well for STT/prose input. Assistant structured output needs markdown stripping fixes (antThinking, headers, bullets) and structural boundary splitting before downstream stages can rely on clean atomic sentences.
recommendedNextSteps: 2. Fix markdown header stripping + treat headers as sentence boundaries
3. Strip inline backtick characters (preserve identifier text)
4. Split bullet items into separate sentences
5. Re-run this evaluation to measure improvement
